					NOT = { this = scope:st_rec_home }
					exists = mg:explosives
					exists = owner
				}
				mg:explosives = { save_scope_as = st_rec_p }
				owner = { save_scope_as = st_rec_c }
				if = {
					limit = { is_adjacent_to_market = scope:st_rec_home }
					root = { set_variable = { name = st_rec_adj value = 1 } }
				}
				else = {
					root = { set_variable = { name = st_rec_adj value = 0 } }
				}
				root = { st_rec_try_partner = yes }
			}
			st_rec_good_end = yes

st_rec_good_start = {
	set_variable = { name = st_rec_best value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = st_rec_bestq value = 0 }
}

# One partner market: rules, inputs, the 10-unit test, then the search.
st_rec_try_partner = {
	if = {
		limit = { st_rec_pair_ok = yes }
		change_variable = { name = st_rec_n_pairs add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_bh value = st_rec_in_bh }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_sh value = st_rec_in_sh }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_bp value = st_rec_in_bp }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_sp value = st_rec_in_sp }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_k value = st_rec_in_k }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_ship value = st_rec_in_ship }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_cap value = st_rec_in_cap }
		# Profitable at its best <=> profitable at 10 units (Market.pays10):
		# the margin per unit only falls as quantity grows.
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = 10 }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_gq value = st_rec_gain }
		if = {
			limit = { var:st_rec_gq > 0 }
			change_variable = { name = st_rec_n_full add = 1 }
			st_rec_search = yes
			set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = var:st_rec_q }
			set_variable = { name = st_rec_gq value = st_rec_gain }
			set_variable = { name = st_rec_d value = st_rec_vs_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:st_rec_d > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_best value = var:st_rec_gq }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_bestq value = var:st_rec_q }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_bc value = scope:st_rec_c }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_bk value = scope:st_rec_g }
			}
		}
	}
}

st_rec_search = {
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_q value = 10 }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_0 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_1 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_2 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_3 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_4 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_5 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_6 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_7 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_8 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_9 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_10 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_11 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_12 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_13 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_14 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_15 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_step_16 }
		st_rec_try_t = yes
		# The cap itself, if profit is still rising there.
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = var:st_rec_cap }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_m value = st_rec_marginal }
		if = { limit = { var:st_rec_m > 0 } set_variable = { name = st_rec_q value = var:st_rec_cap } }
		# The kinks, when near and better.
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_kink_p }
		st_rec_try_kink = yes
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_kink_h }
		st_rec_try_kink = yes
		# One more unit if it pays (whole-unit rounding, run 11).
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = st_rec_q_plus1 }
		st_rec_try_better = yes
}

# A ratio step: take st_rec_t if it is within the cap and profit still rises.
st_rec_try_t = {
	set_variable = { name = st_rec_d value = st_rec_room }
	if = {
		limit = { var:st_rec_d >= 0 }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_m value = st_rec_marginal }
		if = { limit = { var:st_rec_m > 0 } set_variable = { name = st_rec_q value = var:st_rec_t } }
	}
}

# A kink: take it if it lies above q, no further than min(cap, 1.2 q + 2),
# and earns more than q.
st_rec_try_kink = {
	set_variable = { name = st_rec_d value = st_rec_t_minus_q }
	if = {
		limit = { var:st_rec_d > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_d value = st_rec_near_room }
		if = {
			limit = { var:st_rec_d >= 0 }
			st_rec_try_better = yes
		}
	}
}

# Take st_rec_t if it is within the cap and earns more than q.
st_rec_try_better = {
	set_variable = { name = st_rec_d value = st_rec_room }
	if = {
		limit = { var:st_rec_d >= 0 }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_gt value = st_rec_gain }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_m value = var:st_rec_t }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = var:st_rec_q }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_gq value = st_rec_gain }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_t value = var:st_rec_m }
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_d value = st_rec_gain_diff }
		if = { limit = { var:st_rec_d > 0 } set_variable = { name = st_rec_q value = var:st_rec_t } }
	}
}

# After every partner for one good: keep it if it is meaningful.
st_rec_good_end = {
	set_variable = { name = st_rec_d value = st_rec_vs_min }
	if = {
		limit = { var:st_rec_d >= 0 }
		st_rec_insert = yes
	}
}

st_rec_insert = {
		set_variable = { name = st_rec_d value = st_rec_vs_slot1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:st_rec_d > 0 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = st_rec_c4 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_g5 value = var:st_rec_g4 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_q5 value = var:st_rec_q4 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_c5 value = var:st_rec_c4 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_k5 value = var:st_rec_k4 }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_variable = st_rec_c3 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_g4 value = var:st_rec_g3 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_q4 value = var:st_rec_q3 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_c4 value = var:st_rec_c3 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_k4 value = var:st_rec_k3 }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_variable = st_rec_c2 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_g3 value = var:st_rec_g2 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_q3 value = var:st_rec_q2 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_c3 value = var:st_rec_c2 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_k3 value = var:st_rec_k2 }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_variable = st_rec_c1 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_g2 value = var:st_rec_g1 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_q2 value = var:st_rec_q1 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_c2 value = var:st_rec_c1 }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_k2 value = var:st_rec_k1 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = st_rec_g1 value = var:st_rec_best }
			set_variable = { name = st_rec_q1 value = var:st_rec_bestq }
			set_variable = { name = st_rec_c1 value = var:st_rec_bc }
			set_variable = { name = st_rec_k1 value = var:st_rec_bk }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = st_rec_d value = st_rec_vs_slot2 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:st_rec_d > 0 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = st_rec_c4 }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_g5 value = var:st_rec_g4 }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_q5 value = var:st_rec_q4 }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_c5 value = var:st_rec_c4 }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_k5 value = var:st_rec_k4 }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_variable = st_rec_c3 }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_g4 value = var:st_rec_g3 }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_q4 value = var:st_rec_q3 }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_c4 value = var:st_rec_c3 }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_k4 value = var:st_rec_k3 }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_variable = st_rec_c2 }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_g3 value = var:st_rec_g2 }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_q3 value = var:st_rec_q2 }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_c3 value = var:st_rec_c2 }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_k3 value = var:st_rec_k2 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_g2 value = var:st_rec_best }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_q2 value = var:st_rec_bestq }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_c2 value = var:st_rec_bc }
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_k2 value = var:st_rec_bk }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = st_rec_d value = st_rec_vs_slot3 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:st_rec_d > 0 }
					if = { limit = { has_variable = st_rec_c4 }
						set_variable = { name = st_rec_g5 value = var:st_rec_g4 }
						set_variable = { name = st_rec_q5 value = var:st_rec_q4 }
						set_variable = { name = st_rec_c5 value = var:st_rec_c4 }
						set_variable = { name = st_rec_k5 value = var:st_rec_k4 }
					}
					if = { limit = { has_variable = st_rec_c3 }
						set_variable = { name = st_rec_g4 value = var:st_rec_g3 }
						set_variable = { name = st_rec_q4 value = var:st_rec_q3 }
						set_variable = { name = st_rec_c4 value = var:st_rec_c3 }
						set_variable = { name = st_rec_k4 value = var:st_rec_k3 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_g3 value = var:st_rec_best }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_q3 value = var:st_rec_bestq }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_c3 value = var:st_rec_bc }
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_k3 value = var:st_rec_bk }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = st_rec_d value = st_rec_vs_slot4 }
					if = {
						limit = { var:st_rec_d > 0 }
						if = { limit = { has_variable = st_rec_c4 }
							set_variable = { name = st_rec_g5 value = var:st_rec_g4 }
							set_variable = { name = st_rec_q5 value = var:st_rec_q4 }
							set_variable = { name = st_rec_c5 value = var:st_rec_c4 }
							set_variable = { name = st_rec_k5 value = var:st_rec_k4 }
						}
						set_variable = { name = st_rec_g4 value = var:st_rec_best }
						set_variable = { name = st_rec_q4 value = var:st_rec_bestq }
						set_variable = { name = st_rec_c4 value = var:st_rec_bc }
						set_variable = { name = st_rec_k4 value = var:st_rec_bk }
					}
					else = {
						set_variable = { name = st_rec_d value = st_rec_vs_slot5 }
						if = {
							limit = { var:st_rec_d > 0 }
							set_variable = { name = st_rec_g5 value = var:st_rec_best }
							set_variable = { name = st_rec_q5 value = var:st_rec_bestq }
							set_variable = { name = st_rec_c5 value = var:st_rec_bc }
							set_variable = { name = st_rec_k5 value = var:st_rec_bk }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
}
